pg02.intro: Three party breakers have tripped. Flip them back, then take the stairwell up to the midway. Balloons will not hurt you. The people holding them might.

stagesAdd.text: Take the stairwell to the midway

pg05.description: A narrow stairwell the colour of boiled sweets, eight floors in a single shaft. No rooms, no corridors: the stairs are the level, and something climbs them behind you.
pg05.intro: You start at the bottom of the shaft. Eight flights to the door at the top. Something is coming up the stairs after you - keep moving.

stagesAdd.hint: Keep moving: it gains on you while you stand still

pg10.description: Six storeys of mall round one atrium, and every escalator still runs - up. The service stairs on the sixth floor are the way on, into the mirror maze.
pg10.intro: Ride the escalators up through the atrium. Wind the music box on the third floor, then find the service stairs on the sixth. They lead straight down into the next ride.

stagesAdd.text: Ride the escalators to the third floor and switch the music back on
stagesAdd.hint: Every escalator still runs. They only go up.

stagesAdd.text: Keep going up: the service stairs are on the sixth floor

pg15.intro: Blow out the three birthday cakes and take the service stairwell up. The guests will notice.

pg16.description: One great stairwell in candy-cane stripes: twelve flights in a single narrow shaft, and a door on the sixth landing for anyone who cannot face the rest.
pg16.intro: Twelve flights, or six and the door on floor 7. The mascot is climbing too, a few seconds behind you. Do not stop to count the floors.

stagesAdd.hint: Keep moving: it gains on you while you stand still

pg21.intro: Find the two fun house keys in the glass rooms, then climb the stairwell out. The glass is thinner than it looks.

pg25.intro: Throw the two float breakers and take the subway stairwell up. Everyone on the rooftops is waving.

pg27.description: A stairwell tower that goes on past any building: sixteen flights in one narrow shaft. Two landings have a door; the ringmaster follows every step you take.
pg27.intro: Sixteen flights in one narrow shaft. There are doors on the 9th and 13th floors if you cannot make the top. Do not look down. Something is following you up.

stagesAdd.hint: Keep moving: it gains on you while you stand still

pg23.description: A five-storey block of flats round a light well, the lift lobby on every floor, and each lift with a bright little jingle.
pg23.intro: Call the lifts in the lobby. Then climb the stairs across the light well to the fifth floor, where the freight elevator takes you down to the log flume.

stagesAdd.text: Call the lifts in the lobby
Climb to the top floor and take the freight elevator down
stagesAdd.hint: The stairs cross the light well on every floor.

cor01.intro: Nothing lives here. Only the hum, and the feeling of being watched. Find a way out. The roof has holes now. Water comes through them in streams, and something has grown in the carpet. Just past the spawn the ceiling has fallen in over a heap of rubble: climb it, and the top of the ceiling will hold you. Somewhere up there is a roof hatch.

cor06.intro: The security door needs a keycard. Someone left it in a desk drawer. There is no ceiling past the third bay. Take the long way round the edge. Or climb the collapse by the spawn and walk across the top of the ceiling, over everything, to the roof hatch.

cor23.intro: Ring the bell to unlock the main doors. Everything will hear it. The hall past the gym is gone. Every shortcut ends in the same cliff. The ceiling by the entrance has come down: up there, nothing follows you, and a roof hatch leads out.
